title: pm-dispatch charter: add a mechanical self-check to the recommendation item so axis ① (≥50%) derives the letter and ②③④ cannot flip it (maintainer, 2026-09-12)
body:
Filed by the director seat on the maintainer's word (live PM chat, 2026-09-12T01:4xZ: 「立 domain:skills 卡」). ⛔ The charter lives under `.claude/**`, a governed surface (AGENTS.md PD#14): the skills seat authors the change, the maintainer hand-merges it. ⛔ The director seat writes no repo file.

## Governing text

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:756-758` — 「长远合理性权重恒 ≥50%:推荐以长远的读数领起,四轴冲突时其余各轴合起来投不翻它。」「权重按缩小而非扩大特例与契约增生读,⛔ 不据它为投机扩张背书。」「权重是推荐规则不是授权规则」.
- `SKILL.md:753` — 「分歧推荐序按拉动定向:有实测拉动 ⇒ 荐长远形态一次付清;零拉动 ⇒ 荐不扩散。」
- `SKILL.md` 创业阶段不扩散 block — 「过渡也从紧 —— 创业阶段不渐进 … staged 选项仅凭具名外部用户证据才可呈报为推荐。」
- `references/core-rules.md:143` — 「spec 与代码不一致默认改代码,改协议单独立卡非选项。」; `:145` — 「推荐须逐轴给理由、长远权重不低于一半;有拉动荐长远终态一次付清,零拉动荐不扩散。」
- `references/decision-analysis.md` 正文六项 → 推荐项 (current text): 「推荐 + 回退 + 置信缺口:荐一项、给回退项、明说本分析看不见什么。」
- Maintainer, 2026-09-12, verbatim: 「我要求的平台长远合理性占 50% ，但是我觉得你的推荐答案不是，我改推荐的都是从平台长远合理性角度考虑的。」 then 「你要和我讨论四棱推荐为什么选错了答案。需要如何改进。」 then 「立 domain:skills 卡」.

⇒ The RULE already exists. What is missing is a mechanical step in the writing template that makes a violation visible on the card itself. This card adds that step; it changes no rule.

## The failure this closes, measured on decision batch #117 (director seat, 2026-09-12)

| card | seat recommended | maintainer ruled | what went wrong |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| #17238 | A — widen the declared `SessionResponse` to admit `null` | **B** — fix the server | a 「契约迁就实现」 option was recommended; core-rules :143 says code follows spec. Axis ① was scored as "the type becomes complete" (a documentation-truth reading, axis ③'s virtue), and axis ④ ("B is the most expensive and breaking") decided the letter |
| #16678 | B — bulk import only (one name in an existing constant) | **survey mainstream platforms, develop completely for the long term** | a staged half-capability was recommended with measured pull present; :753 says pull ⇒ recommend the long-term end state paid once; the staged-option rule requires named external evidence, none existed. Axis ① was scored as "adds no new authorization shape" — a diff-size proxy, i.e. axis ④ again |
| #17147 | B — tell the truth, do not build | handed to a person | the seat's own ① line pointed at A; the letter followed ④ |
| #17598, objectui#8365 | A / B | agreed | correct only because the long-term option happened to be the cheap one; the ≥50% rule was never exercised |

Root causes, from the director seat's own account to the maintainer: (1) ① was computed as "which option adds the least surface", which is ④'s question, so ④ effectively carried 75%; (2) when spec and code disagreed the seat asked "which is cheaper to change" instead of applying the fixed direction; (3) the seat inherited the triage seat's recommendation instead of re-deriving; (4) ① was scored without an external reference point (how mature platforms model the capability); (5) "breaking" was treated as a veto, contrary to 「创业阶段不渐进」.

## The change

**1. `references/decision-analysis.md`, 正文六项, the 推荐 item** — replace the one line with:

> - 推荐 + 回退 + 置信缺口:荐一项、给回退项、明说本分析看不见什么。**推荐先只按 ① 得出**:一句终态句(两年后该能力在平台上长什么样、主流平台怎么建模,点名参照);②③④ 只调时序与分期,⛔ 不翻字母。推荐段必带自检行:「**只看①选 X;②③④ 是否翻转:否 / 是(理由)**」,答「是」时推荐仍为 X,加一句分期说明。两条硬过滤先于推荐:「契约迁就实现」的选项 ⛔ 不作推荐(spec 与代码不一致默认改代码,改协议另立卡);分期 / 半量方案 ⛔ 不作推荐,除非具名外部用户证据。呈报席 ⛔ 不沿用他席推荐,自行推导;与他席不同时明写差异与理由。

**2. `references/decision-analysis.md`, 四棱卡面块固定形状, the 末尾推荐行** — extend:

> - 末尾一行推荐 + 字母选项(A/B/…),**同一行带自检「只看①选 X;②③④ 是否翻转:…」**,再加一行强制置信缺口:本分析看不见什么。

**3. `SKILL.md:756`** — unchanged (single source of the rule). If the skills seat judges a pointer is needed, one clause: 「自检行见 `references/decision-analysis.md`」. ⛔ No second statement of the rule.

**4. Applicability** — per the file's own 适用面: new records only; existing cards are ⛔ not retroactively edited. The grep-able marker is the literal `只看①选`.

## Acceptance

1. The two edits above land verbatim or with the skills seat's wording improvements that keep the four elements: ①-first derivation with a named reference platform; the self-check line with its literal marker; the two hard filters (契约迁就实现 / 分期半量); no inheriting another seat's recommendation.
2. `grep -c '只看①选' .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` ≥ 2 (the 推荐 item and the 四棱 recommendation row).
3. The rule text at `SKILL.md:756-758` is byte-identical before and after, or carries only the one pointer clause.
4. Merged by the maintainer's hand (governed surface); the director seat's next decision batches carry the line, checkable by the same grep on their card comments.
